summary: Spero Therapeutics filed an 8-K regarding a material definitive license agreement with Innovent Biologics (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. and Fortvita Biologics (USA), Inc. Under the agreement, Innovent grants Spero exclusive rights to develop and commercialize SP001, a monoclonal antibody targeting CD40L, worldwide except China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau. Spero grants Innovent reciprocal rights in those territories. No financial terms, stake percentages, or premiums were disclosed. The agreement includes a five-year non-compete for CD40L-targeting antibodies and a possible three-year option. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned. What to watch: future development milestones and potential sublicensing or partnership announcements.
